snippet.title: Ricochet Raven - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
RICOCHET RAVEN launches on PC April 21st! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4002020/Ricochet_Raven/

Fight your way through levels by ONLY parrying! upgrading your parry abilities  as you go through a run! see how far you can make it in Ricochet Raven launching April 21st!
